name: Fire Gems
body:
School conjuration (creation) [fire]; Level: alchemist 6, sorcerer/wizard/summoner 6

Components: V, S, M (25 gp topazes or 50 gp rubies)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Touch

Target(s): Up to four or eight gems

Duration: 10 min./level or until used

Saving Throw: None or Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: no

This spell is identical to fire seeds, except that 25 gp topazes are substituted for acorn grenades, and 50 gp rubies are substituted for holly berry bombs.
